propositions: Built-in code-review overlays cannot be extended with project-specific trigger vocabulary; only standalone project.* criteria are supported in the project routing overlay
The registry functions glob_triggered_overlays and content_triggered_overlays currently ignore project-defined trigger extensions because they read only committed routing and hardcoded patterns

Project overlay entries keyed by built-in overlay ids should support additive trigger_tokens (literal substring matches on diff lines) and applies_to globs that union with committed globs without replacing them
The project trigger extension mechanism must bypass effective_routing (which has replace-win semantics) and instead read project overlay directly via a new helper to preserve additive union semantics
Malformed project trigger entries (non-list tokens, non-string token values, unknown overlay ids) must be silently ignored without raising exceptions
Token matching must be case-sensitive literal substring matching against unified diff added and removed lines, excluding file headers
